ja: いらっしゃいませ! ご用件は　なんでしょう?

key: If you are looking for Blake Whitaker, you will find him on the top floor.
en: If you are looking for Blake Whitaker, you will find him on the top floor.
ja: ブレイク・ウィテカーさまなら　最上階に　いらっしゃいます。

key: SHELLY: S-so that's why, if you c-c-could tell us where Heather is, um, I would r-really appreciate it.
en: SHELLY: S-so that's why, if you c-c-could tell us where Heather is, um, I would r-really appreciate it.
ja: シェリー: そ、それで……ヘ、ヘザーが　どこにいるか　教えてもらえたら、その……すごく　助かるんだけど。
シェリー: ……あの、ね、ねえ?
ちゃんと　聞いてる?
ブレイク: ああ。
シェリー: あっ! よかった!

key: So, then, um, could you, uh, please tell me?
en: So, then, um, could you, uh, please tell me?
ja: じゃ、じゃあ　その……教えて　もらえる?
ブレイク: いいぜ。
シェリー: ありがとう!
シェリー: あ、あの……

key: SHELLY: Do you think he's just thinking about the answer, o-or...?
en: SHELLY: Do you think he's just thinking about the answer, o-or...?
ja: シェリー: 答えを　考えてるだけ……な、なのかな?
シェリー: あ、あの……すみません?
ブレイク: なんだ?

key: SHELLY: Could-- could you tell us n-now?
en: SHELLY: Could-- could you tell us n-now?
ja: シェリー: い、いま……教えて　もらえる?
ブレイク: へえへえ。
シェリー: ……あの。
ブレイク: どーん! 引っかかったな!
マヌケな　初心者め。

key: BLAKE: All right, so who are you and what're you doing in my house?
en: BLAKE: All right, so who are you and what're you doing in my house?
ja: ブレイク: さてと、お前ら　誰で　俺の家で　何してるんだ?
全然　聞いてなかったんでな。
シェリー: わ、わたしは——

key: SHELLY: Please tell us where Heather is, now!
en: SHELLY: Please tell us where Heather is, now!
ja: シェリー: ヘザーが　どこにいるか　今すぐ　教えて!
ブレイク: ああ、それか。
知らねえ。

key: SHELLY: H-hey! Don't just shrug this off!
en: SHELLY: H-hey! Don't just shrug this off!
ja: シェリー: ちょ、ちょっと! はぐらかさないで!
どうして　さっき　うそを　ついたの?

key: You said you didn't know a girl with pink hair, but you definitely know who Heather is!
en: You said you didn't know a girl with pink hair, but you definitely know who Heather is!
ja: ピンクの髪の子は　知らないって　言ったのに、ヘザーのこと　絶対　知ってるよね!

key: You were supposed to be taking care of her!
en: You were supposed to be taking care of her!
ja: あなたが　あの子の　面倒を　見るはずだったのに!
ブレイク: へえ、そうかい?
なあ、いいことを　教えてやる。

key: There's no need to mince words here.
en: There's no need to mince words here.
ja: 回りくどい　言い方は　抜きだ。

key: We both already know what sides we're each on here.
en: We both already know what sides we're each on here.
ja: お互い　どっちの側かは　もう　わかってる。

key: So I'll make you a deal:
en: So I'll make you a deal:
ja: だから　取り引きしよう。

key: Get me the Ruby Ring, and I'll tell you where Heather is.
en: Get me the Ruby Ring, and I'll tell you where Heather is.
ja: ルビーのゆびわを　持ってこい。そしたら　ヘザーの居場所を　教えてやる。
シェリー: ゆびわを?
でも　あれは　ヘザーの　大事なもので……

key: BLAKE: Is it more important than her?
en: BLAKE: Is it more important than her?
ja: ブレイク: 本人より　大事なのか?
シェリー: そ、そんな……

key: BLAKE: My terms not good enough for you, bro?
en: BLAKE: My terms not good enough for you, bro?
ja: ブレイク: 俺の条件じゃ　不満か?

key: Then I'll throw in something else for you, too.
en: Then I'll throw in something else for you, too.
ja: なら　もう一つ　おまけしてやる。
この　マシンは　どうだ?
たきのぼりの　マシンだ。

key: You were looking for that, weren't you, \PN?
en: You were looking for that, weren't you, \PN?
ja: 探してたんだろ、\PN?

key: Get me the Ring, and you get the girl and this sweet, sweet machine.
en: Get me the Ring, and you get the girl and this sweet, sweet machine.
ja: ゆびわを　持ってくれば　女も　この　極上のマシンも　手に入る。

key: Pretty good deal if you ask me, fam.
en: Pretty good deal if you ask me, fam.
ja: なかなかの　好条件だと　思うがね。

key: Tit for a tat and the whole world wins.
en: Tit for a tat and the whole world wins.
ja: 持ちつ持たれつ、世界中が　得をする。
どうする?

key: SHELLY: I don't like it, b-but...
en: SHELLY: I don't like it, b-but...
ja: シェリー: 気は　進まないけど、で、でも……

key: We have to do whatever it takes to save Heather!
en: We have to do whatever it takes to save Heather!
ja: ヘザーを　助けるためなら　なんでも　しなきゃ!

key: SHELLY: H-huh? But \PN, w-what about Heather?
en: SHELLY: H-huh? But \PN, w-what about Heather?
ja: シェリー: え、ええ? でも　\PN、ヘ、ヘザーは　どうするの?

key: We really need to find her!
en: We really need to find her!
ja: 早く　見つけないと!
ブレイク: 時間は　過ぎてくぜ。
シェリー: わ、わたし……その……

key: I have a really bad feeling about this.
en: I have a really bad feeling about this.
ja: すごく　いやな予感が　するの。
お、お願い?

key: BLAKE: Bro, how much of my time are you gonna waste here?
en: BLAKE: Bro, how much of my time are you gonna waste here?
ja: ブレイク: なあ、あと　どれだけ　俺の時間を　無駄にする気だ?

key: A lot can change in just a few minutes' difference.
en: A lot can change in just a few minutes' difference.
ja: 数分の差で　いろいろ　変わるもんだぜ。

key: SHELLY: This could be Heather's life!
en: SHELLY: This could be Heather's life!
ja: シェリー: ヘザーの　命が　かかってるかも　しれないの!
考え直して!

key: Let me just give him the Ring now and we'll figure it out later, okay?
en: Let me just give him the Ring now and we'll figure it out later, okay?
ja: 今は　ゆびわを　渡そう。あとのことは　あとで　考えよう、ね?

key: BLAKE: You already have the Ring?
en: BLAKE: You already have the Ring?
ja: ブレイク: もう　ゆびわを　持ってるのか?
ブレイク: 話が　早いな。

key: I knew you'd see it my way.
en: I knew you'd see it my way.
ja: 俺の言うとおりに　なると　思ってたぜ。
もう　ゆびわを　持ってるのか?
そいつは　初耳だ。

key: I was told that Fire-type bitch had it.
en: I was told that Fire-type bitch had it.
ja: ほのおタイプの　あのクソ野郎が　持ってると　聞いてたんだがな。

key: Guess that's a little vague though, isn't it?
en: Guess that's a little vague though, isn't it?
ja: まあ　それだと　ちょっと　あいまいか?

key: I meant the one that's not related to me.
en: I meant the one that's not related to me.
ja: 俺と　血が　つながってないほうの　やつだ。

key: SHELLY: Don't talk about Cal that way!
en: SHELLY: Don't talk about Cal that way!
ja: シェリー: キャルのこと　そんなふうに　言わないで!
ブレイク: ああ。

key: You're in with that oaf, are you?
en: You're in with that oaf, are you?
ja: あの　うすのろの　仲間ってわけか?
まあ　いいさ。

key: There's a change of plans anyway.
en: There's a change of plans anyway.
ja: どのみち　予定変更だ。
ブレイクは　ルビーのゆびわを　奪い取った!
シェリー: ちょっと!

key: BLAKE: Like taking candy from a kiddo.
en: BLAKE: Like taking candy from a kiddo.
ja: ブレイク: 赤子の手を　ひねるようだな。
……まあ　似たようなもんか。
俺は　落ちるわ。
縁が　あって　よかったぜ!

key: SHELLY: W-wait! B-but what about Heather?
en: SHELLY: W-wait! B-but what about Heather?
ja: シェリー: ま、待って! ヘ、ヘザーは　どうなるの?

key: BLAKE: I got the Ring already.
en: BLAKE: I got the Ring already.
ja: ブレイク: ゆびわは　もう　手に入れた。
取り引きは　なしだ。

key: Maybe if you look long enough, you'll find her.
en: Maybe if you look long enough, you'll find her.
ja: 気長に　探せば　見つかるかもな。
なんてな!

key: SHELLY: What's that supposed to mean?
en: SHELLY: What's that supposed to mean?
ja: シェリー: どういう　意味なの?

key: BLAKE: You really wanna know, yeah?
en: BLAKE: You really wanna know, yeah?
ja: ブレイク: そんなに　知りたいか?

key: All right, truth is, I got that chick locked up good.
en: All right, truth is, I got that chick locked up good.
ja: いいだろう、実は　あの女は　俺が　しっかり　閉じ込めてある。

key: Regardless, here's how we do this.
en: Regardless, here's how we do this.
ja: とにかく　こうしよう。
ブレイク: 俺は　たきのぼりを　渡す。
そっちは　ゆびわを　よこす。

key: Then I tell you where Heather is.
en: Then I tell you where Heather is.
ja: そしたら　ヘザーの居場所を　教えてやる。
わかったか?
シェリー: わかった……

key: Shelly handed over the Ruby Ring.
en: Shelly handed over the Ruby Ring.
ja: シェリーは　ルビーのゆびわを　渡した。
ブレイク: いいねぇぇぇ。

key: SHELLY: H-hey! Where are you going?!
en: SHELLY: H-hey! Where are you going?!
ja: シェリー: ちょ、ちょっと! どこ行くの!?

key: You haven't told us where Heather is yet!
en: You haven't told us where Heather is yet!
ja: まだ　ヘザーの居場所を　聞いてない!
ブレイク: おおぉぉ、そうだったな。
うっかり　忘れてたぜ。

key: SHELLY: D-don't forget important stuff like that!
en: SHELLY: D-don't forget important stuff like that!
ja: シェリー: そ、そんな大事なこと　忘れないで!
ブレイク: おっと。
わかった　わかった。
正々堂々　いこうじゃないか。
本当のことが　知りたいか?

key: I had to lock Heather up.
en: I had to lock Heather up.
ja: ヘザーは　閉じ込めるしか　なかったんだ。
シェリー: な、なに……?
ブレイク: そうさ!

key: Turns out that chick was giving out food to everyone in the city.
en: Turns out that chick was giving out food to everyone in the city.
ja: あの女、街中の連中に　食料を　配ってたんだよ。

key: See, you probably already knew, but I'm taking orders from Team Meteor.
en: See, you probably already knew, but I'm taking orders from Team Meteor.
ja: もう　知ってるだろうが、俺は　メテオだんの　命令で　動いてる。
カニス・マヨル、ただいま　参上ってな。
よろしくな。

key: So when the mountain path got blocked off--
en: So when the mountain path got blocked off--
ja: で、山道が　ふさがれたとき——

key: Not my fault, btw, just saying--
en: Not my fault, btw, just saying--
ja: ちなみに　俺のせいじゃ　ないぞ、念のため——

key: I got some orders from them to hide all of the city's food.
en: I got some orders from them to hide all of the city's food.
ja: 街の食料を　全部　隠せって　命令が　来たんだ。
断食って　聞いたこと　あるだろ?

key: Monks don't eat for days to, like, cleanse themselves or some bullshit like that, right?
en: Monks don't eat for days to, like, cleanse themselves or some bullshit like that, right?
ja: 坊さんが　何日も　食わずに　身を清めるとか　そういう　たわごとだ。
まあ　それと　同じさ。

key: If everyone in the city starves, this world will be cleansed too.
en: If everyone in the city starves, this world will be cleansed too.
ja: 街の連中が　みんな　飢えれば　この世界も　清められる。

key: Or some kinda wild dogma, whatever.
en: Or some kinda wild dogma, whatever.
ja: とか　いう　イカれた教義だ。知らんがな。

key: Yo, full disclosure, I'm not about all their zealotry, I'm just in it for the outcome.
en: Yo, full disclosure, I'm not about all their zealotry, I'm just in it for the outcome.
ja: 正直に言うと　俺は　連中の狂信には　興味ない。ほしいのは　結果だけだ。

key: Anyway, girl was getting in the way.
en: Anyway, girl was getting in the way.
ja: とにかく　あの女が　邪魔だった。

key: No one's gonna starve to death if they're being given food.
en: No one's gonna starve to death if they're being given food.
ja: 食料を　配られてちゃ　誰も　飢え死にしない。

key: So I got orders to fix the problem.
en: So I got orders to fix the problem.
ja: だから　問題を　片づけろと　命令された。
仕事だ。
恨むなよ。
まあ　恨んでも　いいけどな。

key: I ain't here to make demands, fam.
en: I ain't here to make demands, fam.
ja: 注文を　つける気は　ないぜ。
シェリー: ひどい!
許せない!
ブレイク: おお　こわい、こりゃ　大変だ——
七歳児に　許してもらえないとはな……

key: Man, what am I gonna do?
en: Man, what am I gonna do?
ja: いやはや　どうしたもんかね?

key: Hey, I don't exactly love the idea of locking a kid up either,
en: Hey, I don't exactly love the idea of locking a kid up either,
ja: 言っとくが　ガキを　閉じ込めるのが　好きなわけじゃない。

key: But I care about what you all think about as much as I care about Team Meteor's ideals,
en: But I care about what you all think about as much as I care about Team Meteor's ideals,
ja: だが　お前らの気持ちなんて　メテオだんの理想と　同じくらいしか　気にしてない。

key: Which is to say, not very much.
en: Which is to say, not very much.
ja: つまり　ほとんど　どうでもいい。

key: SHELLY: Huh? Then why are you doing this?
en: SHELLY: Huh? Then why are you doing this?
ja: シェリー: え? じゃあ　どうして　こんなことを?
ブレイク: 俺は　連中を　利用してるだけだ。

key: I'll just do whatever they need and guarantee myself a nice cozy place in the New World.
en: I'll just do whatever they need and guarantee myself a nice cozy place in the New World.
ja: 言われたことを　やって　新世界での　いい席を　確保する。

key: BLAKE: Don't have to deal with anyone I don't wanna.
en: BLAKE: Don't have to deal with anyone I don't wanna.
ja: ブレイク: 会いたくない奴に　会わなくて　いい。
一生　完全な　自由ってわけだ!

key: BLAKE: Your little friend seemed to be interested in the same deal.
en: BLAKE: Your little friend seemed to be interested in the same deal.
ja: ブレイク: お前らの　チビの友達も　同じ話に　乗り気だったぜ。
ルールなし?

key: She came right under my roof.
en: She came right under my roof.
ja: 自分から　俺の家に　転がり込んできた。

key: Makes it all the easier to keep her for Meteor, so, that's that.
en: Makes it all the easier to keep her for Meteor, so, that's that.
ja: おかげで　メテオだんのために　確保するのが　楽だった。それだけの話さ。

key: Anyway, can't stay and chit-chat forever.
en: Anyway, can't stay and chit-chat forever.
ja: さてと　いつまでも　おしゃべりは　してられない。

key: I've got things to do, people to meet, worlds to end!
en: I've got things to do, people to meet, worlds to end!
ja: やることも　会う相手も　終わらせる世界も　あるんでな!
まあ　いつもの　日曜ってやつだ。
じゃあな。
シェリー: そんな……
これから　どうしよう?

key: How are we s-supposed to find Heather if he won't even help us?
en: How are we s-supposed to find Heather if he won't even help us?
ja: あの人が　助けてくれないなら　ど、どうやって　ヘザーを　見つければ　いいの?
何か　考えるから……

key: There has to be something, somewhere that can lead us to her...
en: There has to be something, somewhere that can lead us to her...
ja: どこかに　あの子への　手がかりが　あるはず……

key: Maybe we should ask around outside more...
en: Maybe we should ask around outside more...
ja: 外で　もっと　聞き込みを　したほうが　いいかも……

key: For now, all I gotta do is get this Ring to the boss- man.
en: For now, all I gotta do is get this Ring to the boss- man.
ja: とりあえず　この　ゆびわを　ボスに　届けるだけだ。
ブレイク: だが……

key: Hey, I don't exactly love the idea of locking a kid up either.
en: Hey, I don't exactly love the idea of locking a kid up either.
ja: 言っとくが　ガキを　閉じ込めるのが　好きなわけじゃないんだ。

key: So, if you wanna save Heather, maybe look around here for a bit.
en: So, if you wanna save Heather, maybe look around here for a bit.
ja: だから　ヘザーを　助けたいなら　この辺を　少し　探してみるんだな。
見つかるかもな。
シェリー: 閉じ込めたなんて……
し、信じられない……
見つけないと!
この家を　調べよう!

key: If it's anything like a mystery novel, there might be a secret passage!
en: If it's anything like a mystery novel, there might be a secret passage!
ja: 推理小説みたいに　隠し通路が　あるかも!

key: SHELLY: There has to be something, somewhere that can lead us to her...
en: SHELLY: There has to be something, somewhere that can lead us to her...
ja: シェリー: どこかに　あの子への　手がかりが　あるはず……

key: SHELLY: Hey! I was looking through this bookshelf and found something!
en: SHELLY: Hey! I was looking through this bookshelf and found something!
ja: シェリー: ねえ! 本棚を　調べてたら　何か　見つけた!
これ　見て!

key: SHELLY: Do you think it means something?
en: SHELLY: Do you think it means something?
ja: シェリー: これ　何か　意味が　あるのかな?

key: SHELLY: Let's be sure to check everything thoroughly, even if it looks normal!
en: SHELLY: Let's be sure to check everything thoroughly, even if it looks normal!
ja: シェリー: ふつうに見えても　何でも　しっかり　調べよう!

key: There's no telling where he could have hidden something!
en: There's no telling where he could have hidden something!
ja: どこに　何を　隠してるか　わからないもの!

key: SHELLY: So, Heather is supposed to be locked up here somewhere...
en: SHELLY: So, Heather is supposed to be locked up here somewhere...
ja: シェリー: ヘザーは　この家の　どこかに　閉じ込められてるはず……

key: If what Cal says is true, there must be some way to open a secret passage.
en: If what Cal says is true, there must be some way to open a secret passage.
ja: キャルの言うとおりなら　隠し通路を　開ける　方法が　あるはず。

key: Just like in a mystery novel!
en: Just like in a mystery novel!
ja: 推理小説みたいに!
よし、探しはじめよう。
ふつうの　木だ。

key: Looking closer, there's a number labeled on the pot: "4"
en: Looking closer, there's a number labeled on the pot: "4"
ja: よく見ると　鉢に　数字が　書いてある。「4」

key: Looking closer, there's a number labeled on the pot: "1"
en: Looking closer, there's a number labeled on the pot: "1"
ja: よく見ると　鉢に　数字が　書いてある。「1」

key: Looking closer, there's a number labeled on the pot: "3"
en: Looking closer, there's a number labeled on the pot: "3"
ja: よく見ると　鉢に　数字が　書いてある。「3」

key: Looking closer, there's a number labeled on the pot: "6"
en: Looking closer, there's a number labeled on the pot: "6"
ja: よく見ると　鉢に　数字が　書いてある。「6」
本棚を　調べた……

key: A piece of paper is sticking out from between two books.
en: A piece of paper is sticking out from between two books.
ja: 本の間から　紙切れが　はみ出している。
ベッドの下を　調べた……
……これは　シェリーに　見せないほうが　いい。
木箱の中を　調べた……

key: It's full of food! But nothing else suspicious.
en: It's full of food! But nothing else suspicious.
ja: 食料で　いっぱいだ! ほかに　あやしいものは　ない。
座面の　クッションを　調べた……
\PNは　コインを　1枚　見つけた!
何もない。
ソファの下を　調べた……
\PNは　コインを　3枚　見つけた!
\PNは　コインを　2枚　見つけた!

key: A computer tower. It seems to be ready to go.
en: A computer tower. It seems to be ready to go.
ja: パソコン本体だ。準備は　できているようだ。

key: A computer tower. A CD drive is open.
en: A computer tower. A CD drive is open.
ja: パソコン本体だ。CDドライブが　開いている。
プログラムディスクを　入れた。

key: A computer tower. It doesn't seem to be powered.
en: A computer tower. It doesn't seem to be powered.
ja: パソコン本体だ。電源が　入っていないようだ。

key: Plugged in the computer with the power cable.
en: Plugged in the computer with the power cable.
ja: 電源ケーブルで　パソコンを　つないだ。
パソコンの　モニターだ。
「パスワードを　入力」
「完了」
シェリー: ……えっ!? い、いま　動いた!
「エラー」
「プログラムディスクを　入れてください」
「入力信号が　ありません」
本棚の下を　調べた……
あやしいものは　なさそうだ。
シェリー: \PN! 見て!
見つけたんだね!

key: I feel like we should've been looking for a door with a number '9' on it or something.
en: I feel like we should've been looking for a door with a number '9' on it or something.
ja: 「9」って　書かれた扉でも　探すべきだった気が　するけど。

key: Anyway, let's go! Heather's waiting for us!
en: Anyway, let's go! Heather's waiting for us!
ja: とにかく　行こう! ヘザーが　待ってる!

key: I feel like we should have been looking for a door with a number '9' on it or something.
en: I feel like we should have been looking for a door with a number '9' on it or something.
ja: 「9」って　書かれた扉でも　探すべきだった気が　するんだけど。
